<!-- An accepted ADR is never edited into a different decision: a later record amends it by
     d-handle or supersedes it whole, and the old record gains a pointer. This template is the
     proposal stage of that lifecycle — see CONTRIBUTING.md, "How decisions change". -->

## Affected ADR

<!-- e.g. docs/adr/ADR-0014-http-api-and-mcp-facade.md -->

## Decision handle(s)

<!-- The d-number(s) the amendment changes, e.g. "ADR-0014 d2 and d5".
     An amendment that cannot name its handles is probably a new ADR instead. -->

## Evidence

<!-- Why the accepted decision is wrong or insufficient: the failure scenario, the measured
     fact, the sourced external change (spec revision, upstream capability) that invalidates
     it. Per ADR-0018, an unsourced claim does not carry an amendment. -->

## Proposed change

<!-- The replacement decision, stated as the amending record would state it: what the new
     d-text says, what it costs, and which downstream pages must change with it. -->

## Pages that must change

<!-- The pages that carry the decision's mechanics and would need edits if this is accepted. -->
